summary: Cushing Loc 1 lookout in Nacogdoches County, listed as gone; sources give only coordinates and status, with no build, staffing or site history.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no source describes what remains at the site

evidence.supports: Loc 1 listed in Nacagdoches County at 31.83592, -94.85356, Tower Gone (story spells the county Nacogdoches)
Loc 2 listed at 31.76750, -94.80694, Tower Gone; the two sites are both gone and Loc 1 lies north-west of Loc 2
Central US Lookouts Texas index lists a Cushing site in Nacogdoches County under the Texas Forest Service
the index entry is named Cushing with no Loc number
background only: the Forest Service began building metal lookout towers at strategic locations in the forests
evidence.quote: So the Forest Service began building metal lookout towers at strategic

notes_for_editor: Low confidence. The only Loc 1 record is the association listing (coordinates and Tower Gone). The Central US Lookouts entry names Cushing in Nacogdoches County under the Texas Forest Service but has no Loc number, so this story does not attach it to Loc 1. The companion Loc 2 story (us-tx-cushing-loc-2) cites the same entry for Loc 2 and should be checked for consistency. The association spells the county Nacagdoches; the story uses Nacogdoches, as the other sources do. No build date, design, height, staffing or fire record was found, so those sections are omitted. An AnyPlaceAmerica topo page for Loc 1 returned HTTP 403 and was not read. Worth a check of Texas Forest Service records before expansion.
